title: Place
info: In means inside. On means on a surface. Under means below.
Beside means next to. Between means in the middle of two things.
Behind means at the back. In front of means at the front.

questions.q: A fish in a bowl is
A lamp on a table is
If A is between B and C, A is
options: In the middle of B and C

questions.q: The garden behind the house is
options: At the back of the house
